header.name: [bedrock-research]inventory-ui-slider-rp_v1.0.1
header.description: v1.0.1 - Slider window added to the vanilla chest panel and picked by the container title. Each page is a panel shown when the page key in a slot name matches. A release slider is a custom slider whose drag mapping passes the release on, with one hidden slot button per step, and only the button of the current step is visible. Vanilla chest parts are hidden only by bindings inserted with modifications that read the shared entity_ui_hide_vanilla marker.
